description: Verify that the Return Code of the notification is 0x00 (SD messages)
approach:
[Objective]
This case asserts a single SOME/IP-SD wire-format invariant: Return Code must equal 0x00 (SD messages). The harness drives DUT to emit a qualifying notification, captures it, and validates the field byte-precisely.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester drives DUT to emit a notification (typically by completing OfferService prelude or sending a stimulus message).
2. Observation: captured notification's Return Code == 0x00 (SD messages)   ← key check

[Pass condition]
Return Code on the wire equals 0x00 (SD messages).

[Fail condition]
• Fail_return_code — Return code not 0x00
• Fail_timeout — DUT did not emit a qualifying notification within the listen window

verdicts.Fail_timeout: No qualifying notification within listen window
